title: Allergen nomenclature. WHO/IUIS Allergen Nomenclature Subcommittee.
abstract: This is a revision of the allergen nomenclature system which was proposed in 1986. The nomenclature is for allergens which induce IgE-mediated allergy in humans. A table of allergens with known partial or complete sequences as of December 1993 is given.
journal: International archives of allergy and immunology
